changes.reason: Generic library randomization (e.g. tutor resolution 'then shuffle') is a distinct Layer-2 operation from moving objects from another zone into a library.

semantics.shuffle_library: Randomize the order of cards already in a library (including empty-library cleanup after search). Source and destination are the same library zone.
semantics.shuffle_into_library: Move one or more cards or objects from another zone (hand, graveyard, battlefield, etc.) into a library as part of a shuffle instruction.

shuffle_library: Search your library for a basic land card, put that card onto the battlefield tapped, then shuffle.
Search your library for a card, put that card into your hand, then shuffle.
shuffle_into_library: that player shuffles their hand into their library
Each player shuffles their hand and graveyard into their library
The owner of target permanent shuffles it into their library

changes.policyNote: Suppressing tutor shuffle emission because development gold omitted shuffle_into_library was incorrect — the prior primitive conflated both semantics. Parser v1.18+ emits shuffle_library for generic shuffles regardless of gold coverage; gold is updated separately.

changes.reason: Reserved for zone-to-library shuffle instructions only. Generic 'then shuffle' after search is shuffle_library, not shuffle_into_library.
